item.title: How ideas of a vast censorship network moved from the online fringe to Trump policy
item.summary: This article was produced in partnership with Type Investigations, with support from the Wayne Barrett Project. One morning in April 2025, employees of a small office in the US State Department got the email many of them had been dreading.
